text:
linda: Quick update — new Dedicated A10G pool is live in eu-west-2c and ap-south-1a. This is a targeted inference SKU optimized for mid‑latency, cost‑sensitive workloads (good for transformers at <8k context). Pool names: `dedicated-a10g-eu-west-2c` and `dedicated-a10g-ap-south-1a`.

linda: Capacity initially: ~48 cards in eu-west-2c, ~32 cards in ap-south-1a. We'll scale these by demand over the next 72 hours. If you have customers in flight who need guaranteed capacity, please create a reservation (see CLI snippet below).

linda: Policy change (effective immediately): default cross-tenant burst is capped to 20% of any A10G pool to reduce noisy‑neighbor risk. Existing reserved capacity and committed contracts are unaffected. New reservations can opt into `burst-enabled=true` during purchase if the customer wants higher burst headroom.

marc: Nice. Is there any perf difference we should call out compared to our H100 offerings? Any quantization caveats?

linda: A10G is ~2–3x cheaper per token for int8 paths on common decoder models but higher tail latency vs H100 for very long sequences. Recommend int8 quantized variants for embeddings/short generation; keep H100 for extreme low‑latency 1–2 token turnarounds. We'll add a short perf doc to the model catalog.

ryan: Will this change routing rules? I worry existing apps will suddenly prefer a farther region.

linda: Good question — routing defaults remain region-preference first. New pools are added to the routing table with `region_priority=local` and `cost_priority=medium`. Only if a local pool is saturated will the policy route to these A10G pools. No automatic migration of reserved slots.

sales-ops: Can we get pricing guidance to update quotes? Also need a short blurb for AE outreach.

marc: I'll draft pricing + a short one‑pager, will ping sales-ops. ETA EOD today.

linda: Reservation example (CLI):
```
# reserve 4 cards for 30 days in eu-west-2c
rw-cli dedicated reserve --pool dedicated-a10g-eu-west-2c --count 4 --duration 30d --burst-enabled=false
```

linda: Ops runbook and perf notes: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-a10g> (internal). If you don't have access, DM me.

sre-bot: Autoscaling policy for `dedicated-a10g-*` pools updated: min_replicas=2, scale_step=4, cooldown=120s.

deploy-bot: Background rollout started for network tuning in eu-west-2c — expect ~5m reconnections for active streams while warmup runs.

ryan: Thanks — I'll coordinate with platform teams to check any long‑running streams. Will also update the failover matrix.

sales-ops: Chatted with a customer who wanted ap-south capacity, this is perfect. Thanks 🙏

linda: TL;DR: new A10G Dedicated pools live in eu-west-2c and ap-south-1a; limited burst policy (20% default) to protect capacity; reservations unaffected; CLI + runbook links above. Ping me or @sre if you hit anything weird.

marc: 👍 will add to release notes and product changelog.

linda: filing a short post-launch watch for 72h, will post a follow-up summary with utilization metrics and any hot fixes.
